paragraphs: Imagine Rosé has a completely free Sunday. There is no schedule, no camera, and no one waiting for her.
She wants to enjoy the day, but three ideas sound equally good: staying home with music, taking a quiet walk, or meeting an old friend for lunch.
She can choose only one. Which kind of day would help her feel truly rested?

quickVote.question: What would you choose for a completely free Sunday?

questions: What does a truly restful day look like for you?
When did you last enjoy a day with no fixed plans?
Do you recharge better alone or with other people? Why?
What small plan can make an ordinary Sunday feel special?

randomQuestions: What is something simple you never get tired of?
Which place in your neighborhood deserves more attention?
What skill would you enjoy learning slowly?
What makes someone easy to talk to?
